short_intro: Freshworks builds easy-to-use, affordable SaaS tools for customer support, sales, marketing, and IT teams. Our products are designed to help teams work smarter, faster, and with delight.
target_audience: Startups, SMBs, mid-market companies, and enterprise teams looking for fast, modern customer engagement and internal IT solutions.

products.name: Freshdesk
products.description: Customer support software with ticketing, automation, chatbot, and multichannel support.

products.name: Freshsales
products.description: A CRM and sales automation platform with AI insights, deal management, and pipeline visibility.

products.name: Freshmarketer
products.description: Marketing automation for email campaigns, segmentation, and customer journey workflows.

products.name: Freshservice
products.description: Cloud IT service management platform with incident, asset, and workflow automation.

pricing_overview.note: Freshworks follows a simple per-user, per-month subscription model. Pricing varies by product and plan tier.
common_details: Most products offer a 14–21 day free trial.
Starter plans are affordable for small teams.
Advanced plans are available for enterprises.

faq.question: What does Freshworks do?
faq.answer: Freshworks provides cloud-based customer support, sales, marketing, and IT service management software. Our tools are designed to help teams work efficiently and deliver great customer experiences.

faq.question: Do you have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes! Most Freshworks products offer a free trial so you can explore features before subscribing.

faq.question: How much does Freshworks cost?
faq.answer: Freshworks products follow simple per-user monthly pricing with different tiers. Pricing varies by product and features. I can help connect you to a specialist for exact numbers.

faq.question: Who is Freshworks for?
faq.answer: Freshworks serves startups, SMBs, and enterprise teams. Our products are used by support, sales, marketing, and IT departments.

faq.question: Do you integrate with other tools?
faq.answer: Yes! Freshworks integrates with popular tools like Slack, WhatsApp, Shopify, Google Workspace, Office 365, and more depending on the product.

faq.question: Is Freshworks easy to set up?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Freshworks products are known for fast setup and user-friendly onboarding with minimal technical effort.

faq.question: Does Freshworks offer automation?
faq.answer: Yes. Freshworks offers workflow automation, AI-driven suggestions, ticket routing, marketing automation, and chatbots depending on the product.

faq.question: Is Freshworks secure?
faq.answer: Yes. Freshworks follows industry standards for data privacy, compliance, encryption, and security best practices.
